# Miami Wind

Miami Wind is a dark theme whose palette blends Tailwind hues with Catppuccin Mocha greyscale and Miami Nights accents. Curated swatches cover base, primary, bright, greyscale, text, overlay, surface and background tones.

![Miami Wind screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanakin/miami-wind-obsidian-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Miami Wind"
    author: "hanakin"
    repo:   "hanakin/miami-wind-obsidian-theme"
    slug:   "miami-wind"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/miami-wind"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/hanakin/miami-wind-obsidian-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanakin/miami-wind-obsidian-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply Miami Wind to give Obsidian a Miami-inspired color palette that blends Tailwind hues with Catppuccin Mocha greyscale and Miami Nights accents. Choose from curated swatches for base, primary, bright, greyscale, text, overlay, surface and background tones for cohesive, readable notes."
}
```
